chosen.premise: Zubat colonies can have slightly different ultrasonic frequencies, giving each group its own sonar variation.
chosen.hook: Zubat colonies may not all ‘speak’ in the same frequency.
chosen.visualIdea: Display two Zubat colonies emitting visibly different wave patterns, with frequency meters beside them.
chosen.note: The colony-to-colony frequency difference is unusually specific and genuinely surprising. It is supported by one Pokédex entry, though the ‘speak’ framing is a metaphor rather than a confirmed language system.

candidates.premise: Zubat has no eyes, yet navigates dark caves by emitting ultrasonic waves from its mouth.
candidates.hook: How does Zubat fly when it cannot see?
candidates.visualIdea: Show Zubat's eyeless face, then animate sound waves bouncing off cave walls to reveal its path.
candidates.note: Strongly tied to Zubat and fully supported, but its eyeless echolocation is familiar to most fans.

candidates.premise: Zubat avoids daylight because its thin skin burns in sunlight, forcing it to sleep in caves.
candidates.hook: Sunlight is not annoying to Zubat—it actually burns it.
candidates.visualIdea: Split the screen between a bright sunbeam causing burn marks and Zubat safely hanging in a cave.
candidates.note: The burn consequence is a concrete, visually clear mechanic; the thin-skin detail and sunlight burns are directly supported.

candidates.premise: When it gets cold, Zubat colonies gather together so their bodies can keep one another warm.
candidates.hook: Zubat's survival strategy for cold weather is becoming a living blanket.
candidates.visualIdea: Show scattered Zubat shivering, then clustering into a dense upside-down colony with warmth radiating between them.
candidates.note: A compelling survival behavior with strong visuals, but the cold-gathering claim rests on one entry and the other cited facts only establish communal sleeping.

candidates.premise: Zubat evolves into Golbat at level 22, but reaching Crobat requires friendship at 160 instead of just more levels.
candidates.hook: Zubat's final evolution is unlocked by friendship, not grinding levels.
candidates.visualIdea: Show Zubat becoming Golbat at level 22, then pause the evolution until a friendship meter reaches 160.
candidates.note: The level-versus-friendship contrast is concrete and compelling, though it is primarily an evolution-chain mechanic rather than a unique biological trait of Zubat.

candidates.premise: Even in tight caves, Zubat can fly skillfully by constantly checking its surroundings with mouth-born ultrasonic waves.
candidates.hook: Zubat's hardest flight course is a cave with almost no room to turn.
candidates.visualIdea: Track Zubat weaving through narrow cave passages while sonar pulses map obstacles ahead.
candidates.note: Well supported and easy to animate, but it largely restates Zubat’s familiar echolocation ability without a highly distinctive twist.

rounds.request: None—this angle is strong enough. To make it even stronger, add a source or example clarifying whether different frequencies function like colony-specific communication, rather than merely being slight biological variation.
